Whether hand-flush's four- and five-card figures follow from 'one for each card'. Whether game-won should be derived, or ambiguous because no sentence says the game ends the moment its points are made. And whether the two misprints recorded in five-card-hand-table and five-card-crib-table are misprints, or a counting convention the map has missed.
